role: The downloading-terrain screen shown during a dimension change or respawn while chunks stream in; it sends keepalives and does not pause.
scope_reason: The screen is client presentation; the native engine changes dimension synchronously with no screen (csrc/tests/test_dims.c, out/java/snapshots/end-arrival-s1) and the oracle pins the join to a non-pausing screen (SPEC determinism).

members.name: doesGuiPauseGame
members.note: false; the non-pausing behaviour is what the oracle's join pins

notes: The screen is not drawn natively; its non-pausing behaviour matters to the lockstep and is pinned in the oracle's join (SPEC determinism).
